def draws(seed,n):
    mask=2**64-1
    for _ in range(n):
        while True:
            seed=(seed+0x9e3779b97f4a7c15)&mask
            z=((seed^(seed>>30))*0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9)&mask
            z=((z^(z>>27))*0x94d049bb133111eb)&mask
            z^=z>>31
            if z>=2**64%7:break
        yield z%7
seq=list(draws(1,32))+list(draws(2,32))
entries=[0x4020124c,0x40201268,0x40201284]
passes=[0,0,0]; saved={}; prog={}; rows=[]; counts=[[0]*3 for _ in range(2)]; svc=[[0]*3 for _ in range(2)]; calendar=[]

    calendar.append(counts4096)
